title: Unbounded SPD completion polls in the iMC reader and writer

owner.description: UncoreInitPeim iMC SPD reader and writer

description: Missing completion can trap early boot in unbounded polls, and a timed pre-BUSY expiration still issues a command. The original instructions were reproduced.
remediation: Coupled reader/writer bounded-wait PE candidates. C1 local control flow, C2 hardware recovery. The existing read wrapper retries once. The alternate high-address route is outside this correction.
